prompt: How many Los Angeles Metro Rail stations are served by both the A Line and at least one other Metro Rail line?
answer: 7 stations: Union Station, Willowbrook/Rosa Parks, Pico, 7th Street/Metro Center, Grand Avenue Arts/Bunker Hill, Historic Broadway, and Little Tokyo/Arts District.
